caseName: Harris Trust & Savings Bank v. Salomon Smith Barney Inc.
caseNameFull: Harris Trust and Savings Bank, as Trustee for the Ameritech Pension Trust v. Salomon Smith Barney Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, February 22, 2000. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Thursday, March 23, 2000. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, April 10, 2000. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
